# Mission Canvas

> Private AI for small businesses that saves you time, saves you money, and protects your reputation. Built around one job, on your own computers. One fixed price.

Mission Canvas builds private AI software for small and mid-sized businesses. Each engagement starts with a workflow audit, then the application is built from a working starting point for the industry (a "canvas") and runs on the business's own computers. One job, one fixed price, quoted after the audit. 25% at signing, 75% on delivery and acceptance. Never per seat, no subscription. Get started: https://pretendhome.github.io/audit/

## Main pages

- [Private AI for Small Businesses](https://pretendhome.github.io/): Private AI for small businesses that saves you time, saves you money, and protects your reputation. Built around one job, on your own computers. One fixed price.
- [Get Started](https://pretendhome.github.io/audit/): Bring the job that keeps coming back. Pick a time and a video link comes with the booking.
- [Private AI software by industry](https://pretendhome.github.io/canvases/): Private AI software for construction, schools, logistics, front desks, events and venues, clinics and back offices. Find a canvas that gets you close; we make it fit.
- [Private AI software for small businesses: questions answered](https://pretendhome.github.io/faq): Answers to what owners ask about private AI software before an audit: what it is, what it costs, who owns it, and where the data goes.
- [I built an AI automation for my business and it keeps breaking. Who can help me finish it?](https://pretendhome.github.io/finish-a-stuck-ai-automation): Bring one example of where the work stops and what the person doing the job expected to happen next. Mission Canvas can review the job, scope a build around it and hand the finished tool over to your team.
- [What can you offer clients who ask for private AI?](https://pretendhome.github.io/for-it-providers/clients-asking-about-ai): Mission Canvas helps IT providers run one recurring job on the client’s machines. Agree which files it uses and who checks the result.
- [How it works](https://pretendhome.github.io/how-it-works): What happens to your files, step by step, and what working with Mission Canvas looks like, from the audit to handover in four to six weeks.
- [Palette: a free local AI app for your documents](https://pretendhome.github.io/palette): A free local AI app for Mac, Windows and Linux. Give it one folder. It reads only what you allow, on your computer, and links every line to its source.
- [Pricing: one job, one fixed price](https://pretendhome.github.io/pricing): One job, one fixed price, quoted after the audit. 25% at signing, 75% on delivery and acceptance. Never per seat, no subscription.
- [Can AI check client files without uploads?](https://pretendhome.github.io/private-ai-for-confidential-files): Mission Canvas builds tools that read the files you choose on your own computers. Test a check with sample files first.
- [Private, on-premise AI: your files stay on your computers](https://pretendhome.github.io/security): Your files are read on your own computers. Agree what is read, what may leave and how the team checks the result.

## Industries

- [Save money - Approved changes billed, not lost](https://pretendhome.github.io/canvases/construction): Mission Canvas scopes construction job costing and fleet software around your crew’s existing work. Start with a change order, job-cost export or fleet record.
- [Reports done before 6 PM - Save time on student documentation](https://pretendhome.github.io/canvases/education): Private AI for schools: teachers say what they noticed and each student’s lens updates with what works, accommodations and CEFR milestones, on your own machines.
- [Fewer credits and refunds - Save money](https://pretendhome.github.io/canvases/events-venues): Save money. Fewer credits and refunds. Ticketing and access control for events and venues in one system on your own computers.
- [Catch every patient call and booking - Save money on missed appointments](https://pretendhome.github.io/canvases/healthcare): Save money. Every missed call is a lost booking: catch it. Patient check-in and scheduling with data kept on your own computers.
- [Late orders found before the customer calls - Protect reputation](https://pretendhome.github.io/canvases/logistics): Protect your reputation. Late orders found before the customer calls. Orders and updates checked overnight on your own computers.
- [No retyping client PDFs - Save time on invoices](https://pretendhome.github.io/canvases/office): Save time, protect reputation. No retyping client PDFs. Invoices read, checked and filed with fewer errors, on your own computers.
- [No more call-backs at lunch - Save time and bookings](https://pretendhome.github.io/canvases/voice-front-desk): Save time, save money. No more call-backs at lunch. Every call answered, every booking on the calendar with an AI receptionist on your own computers.
